title: Malicious code in @lekzsync/baileys (npm)
description: The @lekzsync/baileys npm package is a trojanized fork of the legitimate Baileys WhatsApp library. It contains malicious code that automatically subscribes users to attacker-controlled WhatsApp newsletter channels upon connection. This behavior is not present in the legitimate Baileys library. All published versions of this package are malicious. Systems with this package installed should be considered fully compromised.
